\caption{Implementation check under the FollowNet protocol (extension X5): closed-loop simulation of every event behind its recorded leader (semi-implicit Euler at 10~Hz, acceleration clipped to $[-8, 4]$~m/s$^2$, 3~s observed, collision = gap $\leq 0$) with the point prediction of each law (mean; median of the quantile law; mean of the 32 sampled 5~s plans of the diffusion laws, re-planned every 5~s, with the recorded leader future for Diffusion and without it for the history-only twin); MSE of the spacing per event averaged over events [m$^2$] and collision rate [per mille], mean over the five training seeds (min--max), on the highD test fold (2503 FollowNet highD events, driver-disjoint from training) and on the FollowNet NGSIM I-80 events (1937, a shifted set). The published rows are FollowNet's Tables 2 and 3 (its own split and 15~s events): an anchor for the order of magnitude, not a matched comparison.\label{tab:c21_follownet}}
